name: Belc CO., LTD.
summary: Belc CO., LTD. manages a chain of food supermarkets in Japan. The company offers meat products, seafood products, fruit and vegetable products, eggs and dairy products, processed and frozen food products, Japanese daily distribution and paste products, prepared food and bread, sweets and desserts, general merchandise, and other goods, as well as beverages and alcohol. It also provides various recipes such as potatoes dishes, snacks, meat dishes, pan pizza, desserts, salad, rice dishes, soup, flour based foods, vegetables side dished, seafood dishes, noddles and pasta, and drinks. Belc CO., LTD. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tsurugashima, Japan.
